evidence.why: Exact live-field comparison, writes and call arguments.
Collision query updates positions before returning.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's implication that cleanup tests whether a saved item pointer remained unchanged across destruction.
facts.value: Resolves Fighter and ftIceClimberAttributes from gobj and invokes ft_80081D0C, which updates collision positions. On a result other than GA_Ground, a non-null x222C is passed to it_802C17DC. After that call the function reacquires fighter user data and compares the live x222C fields through fp1 and fp2; it does not preserve the pre-call item pointer. Equality clears x222C, death2_cb and take_dmg_cb. The branch then resets x224C and x2250 and passes gobj, false and attribute x8 to ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter.

evidence.why: HammerLanding exception and normal lag consumer.

facts.rationale: Preserves the literal guard, query side effects and cross-file exceptional transition.
facts.value: After ft_80081D0C performs collision processing, a GA_Ground return causes no additional local work. A non-GA_Ground return triggers tracked-item destruction and conditional fighter-side cleanup, resets x224C/x2250 and calls ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter with allow_interrupt=false and landing_lag=attribute x8. The common entry helper selects HammerLanding when ftCo_800C5240 succeeds; otherwise it enters LandingFallSpecial using the supplied interruption policy and lag. The query's enum result must not be equated directly with the fighter's ground_or_air field.
